Today I've seen several posts advocating several forms of global censorship on Voat. One advocates banning image macros, another banning users under 21. Can we please stay away from this toxic mentality? Global, site-wide bans on this site should only apply to illegal content, doxing (not sure if illegal, but if it's not should still be banned), vote manipulation, and similar things. If any of these things ideas for how we can "make Voat better" through censorship are actually implemented, I will be leaving the site. There's no reason for me to be on a small censorship-ridden site when there's a bigger, more active one called reddit.

Also, what's your opinion on the same issue?

I agree with you but lets play devils advocate for a moment.

Have you seen /v/space or /v/news lately? 90% of it is conspiracy posts. The signal to noise ratio in a lot of subs here is really really bad. Without some kind of "guys, lets try to keep this sub at least somewhat legitimate, k?" you'll never curate the kind of community where industry professionals will frequent. One of the awesome things about reddit's AskScience or NASA or Space subs is how many REAL LEGITIMATE professionals post there. They won't bother if their posts get drowned out by "The Black Knight comes to subvert humanity!" type posts.

So yeah, censorship sucks! But on specific subs there needs to be SOME control if you want to build a professional environment.
Ask science on reddit was one of the biggest shill subs. Using it as an example of how things should be done is laughable.

I agree. I'm not saying certain things should not be censored on specific subs so that it stays on-topic. I'm talking about global censorship, stuff that affects the entire site. I agree that mods of certain subs should be able to ban certain things so that the subs stay on track, I just don't want Voat as a whole to be banning things that certain users don't like. That's what we have subverses for. If you don't like what gets posted to one, don't subscribe to it. There shouldn't really be many rules that affect the entire site like some people are calling for.
